result.reason: The operative language adopts the preferred New York governing law and exclusive New York County state and federal court jurisdiction, while retaining the existing submission, waiver, and limited injunctive-relief provisions. The changes are confined to replacing the noncompliant Singapore law and forum. Drafting is professional, though Sections 28.1 and 28.2 redundantly state the exclusive forum, and the comment imprecisely suggests any England and Wales venue would suffice rather than specifically London courts.
